title: Evia Course Packs added to Milos
details: The old Future Milos tools placeholder is now Evia Course Packs
All currently published Evia course routes are available in Milos, including Property Maintenance Operative ST0171
Milos now reads Evia's published course registry so newly released Evia course packs can appear automatically in future
Evia course definitions remain qualification data only; learner names and personal data are not downloaded with course packs
